definitions.explanation: The initial or early phase of a process, condition, or time period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{早期|そうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}する→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧。
{早期|そうき}⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早期|そうき}⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: We aim for an early resolution of the problem.

notes:
{早期|そうき} means "early stage" or "early period" — it refers to the beginning phase of a process, condition, or timeline. Almost always used as a modifier before another noun.

COMPOUNDS:
- {早期|そうき}{発見|はっけん}: early detection
- {早期|そうき}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: early treatment
- {早期|そうき}⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧: early retirement
- {早期|そうき}⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧: early resolution
- {早期|そうき}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: early education

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {早期|そうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}する→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧: to detect at an early stage
- {早期|そうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at an early stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧: initial stage (the very beginning; also used for "early" in diseases)
- ⟦{早急|さっきゅう}→早急：18512_sakkyuu⟧: urgent, prompt (emphasizes speed rather than timing)
